newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated March 6.

-- French government already knew of planned Renault lay-offs in mid-January and chose to avoid involvement but Prime Minister Alain Juppe has summoned Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer to his office this afternoon.
-- CSM magistrates council issues report that attacks the government for ignoring its recommendations on appointment of senior judges and demands new powers to insure a more independent judiciary.
-- Top-level defence meeting on March 4 discussed cutbacks on level of 8,300 French soldiers in seven African nations.

-- Government decree on telephone network interconnections lays foundations for 1998 telecoms deregulation but is designed to protect France Telecom's position. Operating licences may be granted this spring,
-- Danone may spin off packaging subsidiary within a few months. Glass industry insider says U.S. firm Owens Illinois is now in the best position to pick up the unit valued at eight billion france.
-- Cigarette price war looms over French market as Rothmans captures market share with a new cut-price brand, Philip Morris readies retaliation and others follow suit.
-- Alcatel Alsthom's German subsidiary Alcatel-SEL to close plant and cut workforce to 13,700 from 16,000.
-- Matra's German subsidiary AEG Mobile Communication to halt output of mobile phones and lay off 600 out of 1,350 workers.
